Minecraft / Hytale log analysis and sharing platform.

## Authentication

Most endpoints are public. Log deletion requires a Bearer token returned on creation.

## Rate Limiting

All endpoints are rate limited per IP (default: 36,000 requests/minute).
Exceeding returns `429 Too Many Requests` with `Retry-After` header.

## Content Filtering

All submitted logs are pre-filtered for:
- IPv4/IPv6 addresses (full & compressed)
- UUIDs (standard, brace, URN formats)
- Xbox XUIDs (16-digit decimal)
- Session/auth tokens (JWT, Bearer, access_token)
- Client/device/instance IDs
- Minecraft coordinates (BlockPos, Vec3d, command formats)
- Usernames (Windows/Linux paths, USERNAME=)
- Access tokens (various JSON keys, headers)

Filters run in the above order. Original content is not stored.
